items.headline: Manchester United beat Leeds 5-4 on penalties in pre-season friendly
items.summary: United drew 1-1 with Leeds at Croke Park in Dublin, winning 5-4 on penalties. Joshua Zirkzee scored in the match.

items.headline: Carrick: Manchester United want and need more signings before window closes
items.summary: Michael Carrick says United must complete additional transfers before September 1. Club has signed Santos, Tielemans, and Darlow so far.

items.headline: Marcus Rashford named in 26-man squad for AC Milan friendly
items.summary: Rashford included in squad for final pre-season match after loan spell in La Liga. Set to make first appearance since December 2024.
